about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me
about.p1: Full stack developer. I build applications with React, Node and MongoDB, and automate with Python whatever repeats itself: if a task gets done by hand three times, the next one is a script.
about.p2: At Anuubis Solutions I keep web infrastructure running in production: deploys, migrations between providers, performance audits and incident response. Outside work I build my own tools and use Claude Code daily, not as an assistant but as part of the workflow: specs before code, agents that hand work over to each other, and a verification step that has to pass before anything counts as done.

projects.title: Web fleet automation
projects.description: I automated the operation of a fleet of production WordPress sites with Python and Bash scripts: audits, post-deploy verification and migrations between providers. Work that used to be done site by site now runs in a single pass.

projects.title: SaveMyMoneyNow
projects.description: Turns bank statements into a spending dashboard. An assistant handles each bank's format by detecting headers and mapping columns, while rules categorize transactions and catch duplicates.

projects.title: Atalaya
projects.description: A Python CLI that aggregates remote developer roles from eight job boards, scores each match against your profile, and drafts the cover letter with Claude. It has 147 tests and uses mypy in strict mode.

projects.title: Strev
projects.description: A MERN fitness SaaS in private beta, with cookie-based authentication, workout tracking, and personalized routines powered by Claude.
